propositions: ReconcilerConfig lacks a backend selection field and mechanism to choose between Backend implementations at runtime.
The reconciler must resolve a Backend instance from a config-driven key without modifying existing consumer call sites (_load_acli, AcliClient construction, differ/apply modules).
A module-level registry with @register() decorator and select_backend(config) resolver must enable in-tree Backend registration and deterministic lazy loading via adapters/__init__.py.
Config-load validation must reject unknown backend keys via _as_choice() coercer in the [reconciler] config section, with REBAR_RECONCILER_BACKEND env override support.
JiraBackend must be registered under the key 'jira' and select_backend() must return an equivalent Backend (same AcliClient / JiraSettings) as today's direct construction.
Registry state must be resettable for testing via _reset_registry_for_test() context manager to allow FakeBackend registration without process-lifetime leakage.
